ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has a six-membered ring structure, with unsaturated bond lines drawn inside the ring; the top of the ring is connected to an oxygen atom, and the oxygen atom is further connected to a carbon/R group above. There are also several hydrogen labels and negative charge labels in the figure. At the lower right there is another independent H–OR component, and there is a curved arrow; the problem requires ignoring the arrow and excluding all bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning: Count non-hydrogen bonds by component. The six-membered ring itself has 6 C–C ring bonds. The substituent at the top of the ring has 1 ring carbon–oxygen bond and 1 oxygen–carbon/R bond, for a total of 2. In the independent H–OR component at the lower right, the H–O bond is excluded, but the O–R bond is retained, contributing 1 bond. Therefore the total is 6 + 2 + 1 = 9.

method.method_draft: First describe the visual structure, then count non-H bonds component by component: the six-membered ring contributes 6 C–C ring bonds; the substituent above contributes 1 C–O bond from the ring to O and 1 O–C/R bond from O to the group above; the separate H–OR component contributes the O–R bond, while its H–O bond is excluded. Sum 6 + 2 + 1 = 9.

推理：按组件计数非氢键。六元环本身有 6 条 C–C 环键。环顶部取代基有 1 条环碳–氧键，以及 1 条氧–碳/R 键，共 2 条。右下方独立的 H–OR 组分中，H–O 键排除，但 O–R 键保留，贡献 1 条。因此总数为 6 + 2 + 1 = 9。
